name: p2-first-screen

data.price_convention: signals and event returns on adjusted levels close*adj_factor (suspension rows carry null factor -> null return, conservative); tradability gates (price floor, limit proxy) on unadjusted prices

H2-pullback.definition: ret_20_adjusted in top quintile of eligible symbols per day AND ret_1_adjusted < 0

H2-chase.definition: ret_20_adjusted in top quintile of eligible symbols per day AND ret_1_adjusted >= 0

execution.entry: next session open after signal close

fees.disclosure: stamp duty segments are institutional facts (0.1% sell until 2023-08-27, 0.05% from 2023-08-28); commission segments are conservative assumed online-retail rates, NOT the user's actual fee (actual: 万1 all-in incl. stamp, P3 scope); transfer fee ~0.001% omitted

validation.isolation: dev events must exit on or before 2020-12-31 (label-span purge; dev events with later exits are dropped and counted); validation events have signal_date >= 2021-01-01; no return stream overlaps both windows
validation.freeze: events whose hold crosses 2024-12-31 are flagged horizon_out_of_range by the screen layer
validation.history_note: 2015-2024 was inspected by the old project: results are rolling historical validation, never unseen-sample proof

dev_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on dev
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 4 of 6 dev years
top-decile symbol share of total net profit <= 40%
validation_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on validation
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 2 of 4 validation years
selection_rule.multiple_testing: 9 preregistered configs evaluated; only dev+validation passing configs are P2 survivors, at most 2 proceed to P3; any post-hoc re-picking downgrades results to exploratory

benchmarks.pool_equal_weight: per signal date, mean adjusted open-to-open return over all eligible symbols on identical calendar windows (no fees)
benchmarks.random_pick: 3 random eligible picks on every trading day, evaluated through the identical event pipeline (fees and blocks applied), seed 17

h3_gate_check.metric: share of dev-window net profit contributed by the bottom amount_med20 tercile of completed H1-reversal events

kill_criteria_note: mid/high slippage tiers are P3 scope; P2 runs tier-0 (no slippage) only
